content.title: About
content.content: Fruit smoothie is made from whole fruits without any dairy ingredients. It contains added plant protein, making the drink nutritious and suitable for vegans and those monitoring protein intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Blends can include banana, berries, mango, pineapple and other seasonal fruits.
The absence of dairy makes the smoothie suitable for people with lactose intolerance.
Added plant protein is often derived from pea, hemp or soy.
Fruit smoothie retains most vitamins and minerals thanks to the use of whole fruits.
The recipe can be tweaked for specific goals, such as adding chia seeds, flax or nut milk.

items.title: Rich in vitamins and antioxidants
items.content: Fruits provide vitamin C, vitamin A, folate and polyphenols that support immunity and protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: The added plant protein supplies about 15–20 g of protein per serving, aiding muscle recovery after workouts.

items.title: Improves digestion
items.content: Fiber from whole fruits promotes regular bowel movements and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Low sugar when using appropriate fruits
items.content: Choosing berries and low‑sugar fruits helps keep the glycemic index of the drink moderate.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The high water content of fruits helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Allergy to plant protein
items.content: Some individuals may react to pea, soy or hemp protein.

items.title: High natural fruit sugars
items.content: Large amounts of sweet fruits can make the smoothie calorie‑dense and raise blood sugar levels.

items.title: Digestive issues from excess fiber
items.content: Very large servings may cause bloating or diarrhea in sensitive people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the smoothie immediately after blending to preserve vitamins. It works well as a breakfast, post‑workout snack, or light dinner. Optionally garnish with chia seeds, nuts or fresh berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the blend in the refrigerator for no more than 24 hours. Longer storage may lead to flavor loss and reduced vitamin levels.
